editorial.intro: ExxonMobil illustrations feature industrial equipment concepts, transport scenes, laboratory samples and workers in red, white and blue settings.
paragraphs: Pipes, storage vessels and red and blue workwear bring an industrial focus to these ExxonMobil illustrations. Imagined station layouts and machinery sit alongside tankers, laboratory samples and maintenance scenes without identifying a real facility.

Explore {{artworkCount}} drawings, from colored valves and tool carts to black and white workshop benches, hose reels and loading structures. The varied subjects can support personal engineering notebooks, classroom discussions of industrial settings and transport themed visual projects.

editorial.intro: JPMorganChase themed drawings combine navy office objects, symbolic finance scenes and imagined bank branches.
paragraphs: Navy portfolios, silver vault details and miniature storefronts shape this JPMorganChase collection. Illustrated people appear at desks, counters and packing benches, alongside symbolic globes, keys, balance scales and banking concepts.

Choose from {{artworkCount}} artworks including colorful office scenes and black and white objects. The variety supports personal business themed projects and educational conversations about saving, payments, documents and everyday commerce.
